column3: RECIPE.md is PAINT-BY-NUMBERS: a numbered checklist naming every font family, weight, size and leading; every margin, measure and vertical space; the TeX engine and every package with its version; figure-placement rules; and the reference style — as VALUES, never as 'match the existing look'. Written for a session with no memory of this project to execute top to bottom with no judgement call and nothing to debug. The typeface, engine and font-loading discipline are ALREADY DECIDED in ADR-002 and are not the build session's to re-open; RECIPE.md implements them and supplies the METRICS ADR-002 deliberately left unset (size, leading, measure, margins, display-maths spacing), measured from the build rather than guessed

column3: A PREFLIGHT that FAILS LOUDLY on a missing or substituted font, tool or version — no fallback, no nearest match. This is the row that exists because TeX does not fail on a missing font, it SUBSTITUTES: the build succeeds, the metrics change, and the document is merely 'close'. Refusing to build is the feature. IMPLEMENTED in -54: docs/deliverable/preflight.sh, red-proofed by tests/test_preflight_refuses.py, which breaks it three ways (modified font, missing font, unpinned TeX Live) and requires a refusal each time
column4: cmd:cd $HOME/repos/wealth-tensor && test -x docs/deliverable/preflight.sh && bash docs/deliverable/preflight.sh

column3: Every font the recipe names is VENDORED into the repository, or — where the licence forbids redistribution — pinned by exact name and version with a checksum the preflight verifies. 'The same font' has to be a fact on disk, not a hope about the next machine. IMPLEMENTED in -54: 15 Libertinus + Inconsolata OTFs vendored from TeX Live 2026 with their SIL OFL files and a sha256 per file. Fonts were pinned EARLY on purpose -- a font is a dependency, not a layout decision, and ADR-002 records why that does not contradict P13 being last

column3: THE LAYOUT IS REPRODUCIBLE, PROVED NOT PROMISED: rebuilding reproduces the committed page count and the per-page text hash in LAYOUT-MANIFEST.json.
